description: Source code for the 'git replace' builtin command, handling object replacement, grafts, and related operations in Git.

methods.name: show_reference
methods.description: Displays reference information in different formats based on the specified pattern and format.

methods.name: list_replace_refs
methods.description: Lists replace references matching a pattern in specified format.

methods.name: for_each_replace_name
methods.description: Iterates over given object names and applies a callback function.

methods.name: check_ref_valid
methods.description: Validates if a reference name is valid and does not already exist unless forced.

methods.name: replace_object_oid
methods.description: Replaces an object reference with a new object ID, handling ref updates.

methods.name: replace_object
methods.description: Resolves object references and performs replacement.

methods.name: export_object
methods.description: Exports an object to a file, raw or pretty-printed.

methods.name: import_object
methods.description: Imports an object from a file, interpreting its contents.

methods.name: edit_and_replace
methods.description: Allows editing an object and replacing it with the edited version.

methods.name: replace_parents
methods.description: Replaces parent commits in a commit buffer.

methods.name: check_one_mergetag
methods.description: Checks if a mergetag in a commit matches expected tags.

methods.name: create_graft
methods.description: Creates a graft (fake parent) for a commit.

methods.name: convert_graft_file
methods.description: Converts an existing graft file into replace refs.

methods.name: cmd_replace
methods.description: Main function handling the 'git replace' command with various modes.
